package.name: big_bertha_bringup
package.description: Hardware bringup for the physical Big Bertha quadruped (Arduino UNO Q, MG995 servos, YDLidar X2, MPU6050). The hardware_bridge_node talks directly to the arduino-router MsgPack-RPC unix socket (Bridge RPC) to drive the PCA9685 servos and read the MPU IMU on the STM32U585 co-processor — no TCP, no Python relay, no Docker. The autonomy stack (state_estimation, mapping, localization, planning) is hardware-agnostic and reused with use_sim_time:=false.
